name: STACK
summary: Cloud takeoff and estimating with plan measurement, assemblies, proposals and optional field and project management.
differentiator: Offers a free version of Takeoff & Estimate, so you can run a live bid through it before paying the listed $299 per user per month. STACK says most teams are running in a few hours, which is its argument against desktop takeoff tools.
pricing: Takeoff & Estimate starts at $299 per user per month, Build & Operate at $49 per user per month and the full platform at $348 per user per month. A free version of Takeoff & Estimate and a two-week trial of Build & Operate are offered.
entryPrice: Free version; paid from $299 per user per month
bestFor: Estimators who want to test cloud takeoff on a real bid for free first.
skipIf: You only measure a few simple plans a month; a PDF tool costs far less.
